segments.name: Leasing and Related Operations
segments.description: Leases commercial aircraft and engines to operators and MROs worldwide, providing lease rent and maintenance reserve revenues.
segments.evidence: Our strategy is to lease aircraft and aircraft engines and provide related services to a diversified group of commercial aircraft operators and maintenance, repair and overhaul organizations ("MROs") worldwide.

segments.name: Spare Parts Sales
segments.description: Sells aircraft engine parts and materials acquired or consigned from third parties or leasing portfolio.
segments.evidence: Our wholly-owned and vertically-integrated subsidiary Willis Aero primarily engages in the sale of aircraft engine parts and materials through the acquisition or consignment of engines from third parties or from the leasing portfolio.

revenueModel.text: Commercial aircraft operators and MROs pay monthly lease rent and maintenance reserve fees for leased engines and aircraft.
revenueModel.evidence: Payment terms of our leases are predominantly monthly in advance for rent and in arrears for the expenses associated with the use of the engines.
